personal.title: Personal Information
personal.tooltip: Contact details so Treasury can reach you if there is any issue with your payment.
personal.fullNameTooltip: Taken from your profile. If you need to change it, contact support.
personal.emailTooltip: Email where we will notify you when a commission deposit is processed.
personal.phoneTooltip: Contact number so Treasury can reach you in case of clarifications.

fiscal.title: Tax Information
fiscal.tooltip: Information required by the SAT to calculate ISR and IVA withholdings on your commissions.
fiscal.note: Your tax certificate must indicate Régimen de Sueldos y Salarios e Ingresos Asimilados a Salarios.
fiscal.curpTooltip: Clave Única de Registro de Población (18 characters). You can find it on your birth certificate or at consulta.curp.gob.mx
fiscal.rfcTooltip: Registro Federal de Contribuyentes (12-13 characters). You can find it on your Constancia de Situación Fiscal.
fiscal.ineNumberTooltip: Card number shown on the back of your INE (voter ID card).
fiscal.taxRegimeTooltip: The regime shown on your Constancia de Situación Fiscal from the SAT. It determines how your withholdings are calculated.

banking.title: Bank Details
banking.tooltip: Account where your commissions will be deposited. It must be in your name and be a Mexican bank account with CLABE.
banking.note: The account must be in the name of the distributor who will receive the commissions.
banking.bankTooltip: Name of your bank. E.g.: BBVA, Banorte, Santander, HSBC, etc.
banking.clabeTooltip: The CLABE is an 18-digit number that identifies your bank account. You can find it on your statement, your bank's app, or the account cover sheet.
banking.accountHolderTooltip: Exact name as it appears on your statement. It must match your registered distributor name.

documents.title: Required Documents
documents.tooltip: Legible scans or photos of your documents. JPG, PNG and PDF are accepted. Maximum 5MB per file.
documents.note: Upload legible photos or scans. The Treasury team will review and validate them.
documents.ineHint: Photo of both sides. Your name, photo and card number must be clearly visible.
documents.taxIdHint: Download it from the SAT portal. It must indicate the régimen de Sueldos y Salarios e Ingresos Asimilados a Salarios.
documents.bankStatementHint: Bank document showing your name, the bank's name and the full CLABE interbank number.
